about.text_about_cit_body: A software engineering company that turns business needs into reliable technology.
about.experience: More than 20 years of experience in Information Technology
about.company_details: Constantino IT Consulting was born from more than two decades of hands-on experience in software development and IT consulting. Over these years we have closely followed the evolution of computing, from client-server systems to the web, mobile devices, the cloud and, more recently, artificial intelligence, working on projects in Brazil, the United States and Italy. Based in Curitiba, Brazil, we serve clients of different sizes and industries, combining solid engineering practices with a clear understanding of each business. This experience gives us the confidence to deliver high-quality solutions, with honest communication and commitment from the first conversation to support after delivery.
about.mission_text: To create innovative and reliable software solutions that meet our clients' real business needs. We seek to understand each challenge in depth before proposing technology, delivering systems that are simple to use, secure and ready to grow with the business, always with transparency about scope, deadlines and costs.
about.business_insight_text: To be a reference IT company in the international market, recognized for the quality of our work and for the long-term relationships we build. We want each project to become a lasting partnership in which our clients see technology as a real driver of growth rather than a cost.
about.our_values_text: Respect, dedication, serious work and maturity are constant values in our organization. In practice, this means keeping our commitments, communicating openly, even when something goes wrong, treating our clients' data and information with confidentiality, and continuously investing in learning so that we can always offer up-to-date solutions.

services.header_text_body: What we can offer your company, from the first idea to a solution running in production.
services.software_factory_text: We develop custom software for your business, choosing the technologies that best fit your needs, budget and growth plans. Our work covers the full cycle: requirements gathering, UX/UI design, development, automated testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance. We work in short, iterative cycles with frequent deliveries, so you can follow progress, validate each step and adjust priorities along the way. Our know-how is reflected in the final quality: clean, documented code that is easy to maintain.
services.expert_consultants_text: We have an experienced team ready to support your company in critical areas. Whether you need a specialist to join your team for a specific project, a technical assessment of an existing system or help planning a new initiative, our experience and professional network allow us to offer practical, well-founded solutions. We work side by side with your team and share knowledge, so that the value stays in your company after the engagement ends.
services.areas_consultancy_text: We work across several areas of Information Technology, including custom software development; web, mobile and cloud solutions; software architecture and modernization of legacy systems; business process analysis and optimization; systems integration and APIs; IT security and data protection best practices; infrastructure and DevOps; websites and visual identity; and the adoption of artificial intelligence in business processes.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: People, expertise, and passion behind every solution
team.intro: Our team is made up of experienced professionals who combine technical excellence with a deep understanding of business challenges. Depending on the needs of each project, we bring together developers, architects, designers and specialists from our professional network, always coordinated directly by our founder. We work collaboratively and close to our clients to deliver reliable, scalable and innovative digital solutions.
team.values_body: We believe in transparency, technical excellence and long-term partnerships. Quality, ownership and continuous improvement guide everything we do: we take responsibility for the results we deliver and keep our clients informed at every stage.
team.expertise_body: Our professionals have solid experience in mobile development, web technologies, cloud platforms, enterprise architecture and systems integration. We closely follow the evolution of the market and apply up-to-date tools and methodologies, including agile practices, DevOps and AI-assisted development.
team.culture_body: We foster a culture of learning, collaboration and innovation, where knowledge sharing and continuous growth are part of our daily routine. We value clear communication, respect for different points of view and the satisfaction of solving hard problems well.
team.profile_bio: Ademir holds a degree in Information Systems from Centro Universitário Leonardo da Vinci (UNIASSELVI, 2010), a specialization in Software Engineering from the Pontifical Catholic University of Paraná (PUCPR, 2014) and a postgraduate degree in Software Engineering from the University of Liverpool, England (2018). For over twenty years he has been developing software solutions at an international level, having worked in major software hubs in Brazil, the United States and Italy.

services_pages.mobile_subtitle: Native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android, built with proven processes and modern technologies.
services_pages.mobile_overview_body: We build high-performance mobile applications designed to scale with your business. Whether it is an app for your customers, a tool for field teams or a mobile version of an existing system, our solutions focus on usability, security and long-term maintainability. We take care of the whole journey, from validating the idea and designing the interface to publishing on the App Store and Google Play, delivering consistent experiences on iOS and Android.
services_pages.mobile_technology_body: Our apps are built with modern frameworks such as React Native and Flutter, which allow a single code base for both platforms, and with native development in Swift and Kotlin when performance or access to specific device features requires it. We integrate cloud backends, REST and GraphQL APIs, push notifications, offline operation, analytics and secure authentication such as OAuth 2.0 and biometrics, ensuring reliability and performance.
services_pages.mobile_process_body: We follow an agile, iterative approach. We start with requirements analysis and UX design, including prototypes you can try before development begins. We then develop in short cycles, with frequent deliveries of testable versions, continuous testing and regular feedback from you. This ensures transparency, flexibility to adjust priorities and predictable delivery timelines.
services_pages.mobile_delivery_body: Quality is built into every stage. We apply automated testing, code reviews, performance monitoring and security best practices to guarantee stable releases. We guide you through the App Store and Google Play publishing process, monitor crashes and usage after launch, and offer ongoing maintenance to keep the app up to date with new operating system versions and the needs of your users.
services_pages.web_subtitle: Modern, scalable and high-performance web solutions, from corporate websites to complex systems.
services_pages.web_overview_body: We develop robust, scalable web applications designed to support complex business processes and high user demand. Our work covers corporate websites, customer portals, management systems, dashboards, e-commerce and SaaS platforms. Every project starts with understanding your users and goals, so that the solution is not only technically sound but also simple and pleasant to use.
services_pages.web_technology_body: Our stack includes React, Angular and Vue on the front end, with TypeScript for safer, more maintainable code. On the back end we work with Node.js, Java (Spring Boot) and Python, relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB, and REST and GraphQL APIs to integrate with other systems. We choose each technology according to the needs of the project, not trends.
services_pages.web_architecture_body: We design modular, maintainable architectures that support long-term evolution and easy integration. We apply principles such as clean architecture, separation of concerns and well-defined APIs, and we evaluate when a monolith, modular services or microservices make the most sense. The result is a system your team can understand, extend and scale without having to rewrite everything.
services_pages.web_quality_body: Performance optimization, security and automated testing are integral parts of our delivery pipeline. We work on fast loading times, responsive design for every screen size, accessibility and SEO best practices. We follow OWASP security recommendations, use continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) and monitor applications in production to detect and fix problems quickly.
services_pages.cloud_subtitle: Reliable, secure and scalable cloud infrastructures, with costs under control.
services_pages.cloud_overview_body: We help organizations design, migrate and optimize cloud infrastructures for performance and cost efficiency. Whether you are taking your first steps in the cloud, moving systems out of your own data center or looking to reduce the bill of an existing environment, we assess your current scenario and propose a plan with clear stages, measurable benefits and minimal impact on your operations.
services_pages.cloud_platforms_body: We work with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), selecting the right services for each business scenario. This includes virtual machines and containers (Docker and Kubernetes), serverless functions, managed databases, storage and content delivery networks. We also design hybrid and multi-cloud architectures when they make sense for your business.
services_pages.cloud_devops_body: With Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and similar tools), CI/CD pipelines and automated monitoring, deployments become fast, repeatable and reliable. We automate everything from build and testing to production releases, reducing manual errors and allowing your team to ship new versions frequently and with confidence.
services_pages.cloud_security_body: We apply cloud security best practices: identity and access management based on least privilege, encryption of data in transit and at rest, network segmentation and auditing. We set up monitoring and alerts, backup and disaster recovery strategies and high-availability architectures, ensuring resilience and continuity for your business. We also review costs continuously to avoid waste.
services_pages.consulting_subtitle: Strategic guidance to turn your digital vision into reality.
services_pages.consulting_overview_body: We support organizations with expert guidance on technology, processes and architecture. Our consulting is practical: we start by understanding your business, your current systems and your goals, and we deliver clear recommendations with priorities, estimates and risks. We can help with a specific question, such as choosing a technology, or support your company on an ongoing basis as a technical partner.
services_pages.consulting_strategy_body: We align technology decisions with business goals, ensuring long-term value and scalability. We help you build a technology roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, choose suppliers and tools, size teams and budgets, and define indicators to measure results. The goal is to invest in what really brings returns to your business.
services_pages.consulting_architecture_body: Our experts help design secure, scalable and future-proof system architectures. We carry out technical assessments of existing systems, identifying bottlenecks, technical debt and security risks, and propose an evolution plan. We also support the modernization of legacy systems, migration to the cloud and the definition of integration standards between applications.
services_pages.consulting_transformation_body: We guide organizations through digital transformation initiatives, from planning to execution. This includes mapping and automating processes, integrating systems, using data for decision-making and adopting artificial intelligence where it brings real gains. We work closely with your team, prioritizing quick wins and transferring knowledge so that the change is sustainable.

mentoring.title: Mentoring
mentoring.subtitle: I can help you improve your technical skills in the Software Development field.
mentoring.overview_body: With more than twenty years building software in Brazil, the United States and Italy, I offer one-on-one mentoring for developers who want to level up. Together we turn real-world experience into practical lessons: writing cleaner code, making better design decisions, and building the confidence to take on bigger challenges in your career.
mentoring.topic_architecture_body: Design patterns, clean architecture, SOLID principles and how to structure systems that are easy to evolve.
mentoring.topic_frontend_body: Modern web apps with React, Angular and TypeScript: components, state management, performance and accessibility.
mentoring.topic_backend_body: Java, Node.js and Python services, REST and GraphQL APIs, databases and integration best practices.
mentoring.topic_cloud_body: Deploying to the cloud, CI/CD pipelines, containers and observability for reliable production systems.
mentoring.topic_ai_body: Using AI assistants and LLMs productively in your daily work, and integrating AI features into your applications.
mentoring.topic_career_body: Code reviews, technical interviews, communication with teams and planning your next step as a professional.
mentoring.format_body: Mentoring is tailored to your goals and current level. Sessions are held online, combining conversation, code reviews and pair programming on real problems, so that every meeting ends with something concrete you can apply.
mentoring.languages_note: Mentoring sessions are available only in English, Portuguese and Italian.
mentoring.step_assessment_body: We start with a conversation about your background, your goals and the skills you want to strengthen.
mentoring.step_plan_body: Based on that, I prepare a personalized roadmap with topics, exercises and recommended resources.
mentoring.step_practice_body: We meet regularly to work on code together, review your progress and adjust the plan as you grow.
mentoring.audience_body: Mentoring is ideal for students and junior developers starting their careers, mid-level professionals aiming for senior roles, and developers moving into a new technology or stack. It also works for small teams that want guidance on code quality and engineering practices.
mentoring.cta_text: Ready to take the next step in your developer journey? Get in touch and let's talk about your goals.
